<marek_celo> > <marek_celo>  Great! Here's the 1 sentence pitch. Let us know if you want more detail:

This talk would outline our experience building a Halo2 prover/verifier that can verify BW6 groth16 proofs efficiently on Ethereum, allowing us to verify Celo's Plumo light client proofs efficiently on Ethereum. (re @Phil_ngo: No official form as of right now. Feel free to pitch/signal it in here and when we organize the schedule we’ll reach out!)
